target.title: fix: unblock gateway protocol CI after managed worktree schema update
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where the managed-worktree gateway protocol schema update leaves main CI red because the public protocol barrel imports two type-only names that it does not use.

The failing checks report:

- `packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.ts(386,8): error TS6133: 'SessionWorktreeInfo' is declared but its value is never read.`
- `packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.ts(390,8): error TS6133: 'SessionsCreateResult' is declared but its value is never read.`

## Why This Change Was Made

The barrel still imports and exports `SessionWorktreeInfoSchema` and `SessionsCreateResultSchema`; the public TypeScript names are already exported from `packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/types.ts`. Removing only the unused local type imports keeps the protocol schema surface intact while restoring the prod typecheck and lint contract.

## User Impact

No runtime or API behavior changes. Developers and maintainers get green gateway protocol type/lint checks again after the managed-worktree schema update.

## Evidence

Testbox-through-Crabbox could not start in this checkout because the selected `crabbox` binary failed its own `--version/--help` sanity check before project code ran.

Local focused fallback proof:

- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-gateway-protocol-fix.tsbuildinfo`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --threads=1 packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/worktrees.test.ts packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/agents-models-skills.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`
